name: Prime Minister’s Fellowship for Doctoral Research
briefDescription: The Prime Minister's Fellowship for Doctoral Research gives selected PhD scholars twice the standard JRF/SRF fellowship — funded equally by the government and industry partner — plus ₹2 lakh/year for research expenses, for up to four years.
descriptionMd:
The Prime Minister's Fellowship for Doctoral Research is a prestigious initiative of SERB (Science and Engineering Research Board) and FICCI (Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce & Industry), under the Department of Science & Technology. It was launched to attract the best talent into high-quality research by doubling the stipend a fellow receives, while also pairing each fellow with an **industry co-supervisor** — so research has direct real-world application.

Up to **100 new fellowships** are awarded each year, split equally between STEM and social-science fields. Half the funding comes from the Government of India; the other half from the partnering industry organisation.
benefitsMd:
- **Fellowship stipend at twice the standard JRF/SRF rate** — if the base JRF rate is ₹37,000/month, a PM Fellow gets ₹74,000/month (or the prevailing doubled rate).
- **Contingency grant of ₹2 lakh per year** for research-related expenses (books, equipment, travel, conferences).
- Duration: **up to 4 years** (for candidates who have already been enrolled in a PhD programme for less than 14 months when applying).
- An **industry mentor/co-supervisor** who guides research toward practical outcomes and improves employability post-PhD.
- Recognition as a PM Fellow — a nationally acknowledged research credential.
eligibilityMd:
- Must be an **Indian citizen**.
- Must be enrolled as a **full-time PhD scholar** in any recognised Indian university, institute or national research laboratory.
- PhD registration date must be **not more than 14 months before the application submission date** (i.e. you must be in the early stage of your PhD).
- Research area must align with one of the notified priority sectors for the call.
exclusionsMd:
- Part-time PhD scholars are **not eligible**.
- PhD scholars who registered more than 14 months before the application date are **not eligible**.
applicationMd:
Applications are invited through specific call notices from SERB-FICCI:

**Step 1:** Register as a student on the PMFDS portal at [primeministerfellowshipscheme.in](http://www.primeministerfellowshipscheme.in/) or [serbficci-iirrada.in](http://www.serbficci-iirrada.in/).
**Step 2:** Fill in your personal details, PhD registration date and research area.
**Step 3:** Write your **Research Proposal** and identify a potential **Industry Partner** willing to co-supervise your work.
**Step 4:** Submit your application with supporting documents — PhD enrollment letter, supervisor's endorsement, university approval.
**Step 5:** Shortlisted candidates are called for an interview; selected fellows sign an agreement with SERB-FICCI and the industry partner.
